note: Targets at an edge: of their scroll view (cut, a sliver, outside its clip, a sticky header) or of the screen (off it, resting in the status band) — phase 3 B2 (calibration.json: #4, #9, #10, #12, #13, #17, #29). Each target lies in a scroll view (`scrollView`, the clip LabState.scrollViews reports) at a fixed place in its content, scrolled to a fixed offset on appear, so its measured geometry (truth.ts#geometryOf) is what its comment in the app files says. `slot` is only the target's order. App files: AveriLab/Edges.swift, Edges.kt (the layout tables: the same numbers, points on iOS, dp on Android).
